verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents platform-run card issuance and program management: virtual and physical cards, production and shipping, a monitoring dashboard, and the full credit lifecycle. It also escalates disputes with the card brands and supports Visa and Mastercard tokenization, which implies it handles the network relationship. On timing, it documents a record of 11 days from kickoff to the first real-world transaction with a virtual card. However, nothing explicitly states that Pomelo provides BIN sponsorship or network membership so the founder avoids bank or licensing requirements, and the 11 days is a best case rather than a typical signup-to-live-card timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship / issuing-bank partnership documentation, explicit statement that network membership is handled by Pomelo, typical (not record) signup-to-first-card timeline, independent corroboration.
